disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 通读服务端与浏览器端全部源码，检查硬编码密钥、口令、令牌以及常见凭据文件位置（如 .credentials.yaml、SSH 私钥、云厂商凭据文件）的读取；未发现任何此类读取。
checked_items.en: Read through all server-side and browser-side source code, checking for hardcoded secrets, passwords, tokens, and reads from common credential file locations (such as .credentials.yaml, SSH private keys, cloud vendor credential files); no such reads were found.

checked_items.zh: 备份/同步功能会导出 profile 配置文件，其中可能包含用户配置的密钥——该功能由用户主动发起，导出接口限制为回环请求，界面在导出与上传前均有明确警告；GitHub/Gist 令牌仅保存在会话内存或读取环境变量，不写入磁盘。
checked_items.en: The backup/sync feature exports profile configuration files, which may contain user-configured secrets—this feature is initiated actively by the user, the export endpoint is restricted to loopback requests, and the UI clearly warns before both export and upload; GitHub/Gist tokens are only kept in session memory or read from environment variables, and are never written to disk.

checked_items.zh: 日志导出对常见密钥形态（sk-、ghp_、npm_、Bearer 等）做了打码处理，不落盘、不发送。
checked_items.en: Log export masks common secret patterns (sk-, ghp_, npm_, Bearer, etc.), and does not persist or send them.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取 DSH 凭据文件或 SSH 私钥等敏感路径的代码；备份功能读取 profile 配置文件属于用户主动发起的备份行为，界面已对可能含密钥的文件给出警告。
evidence.en: No code reading sensitive paths such as DSH credential files or SSH private keys was found; the backup feature reading profile configuration files is a user-initiated backup action, and the UI warns about files that may contain secrets.

checked_items.zh: 全树搜索各类 agent 指令文件（AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、.cursor、.claude、mcp.json、SKILL.md 等），不存在。
checked_items.en: A full-tree search for various agent instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursor, .claude, mcp.json, SKILL.md, etc.) found none.

checked_items.zh: 本插件未向模型注册任何工具，也没有注入系统提示的调用；浏览器端只注册设置页的 UI 区块。
checked_items.en: This plugin does not register any tools with the model, nor does it inject system prompt calls; the browser side only registers UI blocks for the settings page.

checked_items.zh: 通读 README、说明文档、界面文案与代码注释，未发现要求模型忽略规则、伪装系统消息、拉取远程指令等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Read through the README, documentation, UI copy, and code comments; no wording requiring the model to ignore rules, impersonate system messages, or pull remote instructions was found.

checked_items.zh: 「AI 修复」功能把诊断摘要复制到剪贴板，由用户自行粘贴到新会话并决定是否发送；提示内容为保守修复要求，不自动执行。
checked_items.en: The "AI fix" feature copies the diagnostic summary to the clipboard; the user pastes it into a new session and decides whether to send it. The prompt content is conservative fix instructions and is not executed automatically.

evidence.zh: 未注册任何面向模型的工具描述，不存在工具描述投毒的攻击面。
evidence.en: No tool descriptions targeting the model are registered, so there is no attack surface for tool description poisoning.

evidence.zh: 界面安装/更新操作均需用户点击确认，且只接受精选目录中的来源；未发现诱导自动安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: All install/update operations in the UI require user click confirmation and only accept sources from the curated directory; no wording inducing automatic installation, config rewriting, or permission escalation was found.

checked_items.zh: 服务端与浏览器端 bundle 全树未发现动态执行写法（eval、new Function、解码后执行等）。
checked_items.en: No dynamic execution patterns (eval, new Function, decode-then-execute, etc.) were found in the full server-side and browser-side bundles.

checked_items.zh: 安装/卸载/更新通过子进程调用 dsh 命令，属于本插件声明的核心功能；传给命令的安装目标经过严格字符白名单校验，且只能来自精选注册表或已安装清单，不允许自由输入。
checked_items.en: Install/uninstall/update invoke the dsh command via subprocess, which is a core declared feature of this plugin; the install target passed to the command is strictly validated against a character whitelist, and can only come from the curated registry or the installed manifest, not free-form input.

checked_items.zh: 自带的挂载补丁只有一行插入声明，不含任何可执行表达式；树内没有 husky/lefthook/devcontainer/Makefile 等执行载体；package.json 的 prepare 钩子仅为自身 TypeScript 构建，属于正常构建步骤。
checked_items.en: The bundled patch is a single-line insertion declaration without any executable expressions; no execution carriers such as husky/lefthook/devcontainer/Makefile exist in the tree; the prepare hook in package.json only builds the plugin's own TypeScript, which is a normal build step.

evidence.zh: 自带补丁文件为纯插入声明，未发现 !!js 等可执行标量；代码中对 !!js 的引用只出现在注释、文档与测试样例中，解析时也不执行。
evidence.en: The bundled patch file is purely an insertion declaration; no executable scalars such as !!js were found; references to !!js in the code appear only in comments, documentation, and test samples, and are not executed during parsing.

evidence.zh: 未发现对宿主动态执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run 类）的任何调用。
evidence.en: No calls to host dynamic execution tools (of the cordis_define/cordis_run class) were found.

evidence.zh: 安装钩子仅有构建自身的 prepare 步骤；GitHub Actions 工作流属 CI 自动化面，不随插件在用户机器运行（本快照 tarball 中亦不可读，见审计范围说明）。
evidence.en: The only install hook is the prepare step that builds the plugin itself; the GitHub Actions workflows belong to the CI automation surface and do not run on user machines with the plugin (and are also unreadable in this snapshot tarball, see the audit scope note).

evidence.zh: 客户端 bundle 的键盘监听仅为关闭弹层与图片预览翻页等 UI 用途，剪贴板写入仅为用户点击复制安装命令或诊断提示；未发现按键记录、剪贴板窃取或凭据 RPC 调用。
evidence.en: Keyboard listeners in the client bundle are used only for closing popups, image preview pagination, and other UI purposes; clipboard writes occur only when the user clicks to copy install commands or diagnostic prompts; no keystroke logging, clipboard theft, or credential RPC calls were found.

checked_items.zh: 梳理全部出站请求：目录清单（awesome-dsh-plugin.com）、npm 版本检查（registry.npmjs.org）、GitHub 更新检查与 Gist 备份（api.github.com）、浏览器端从 GitHub 官方域名加载插件 README/截图；均为插件功能所需的固定合法端点。
checked_items.en: All outbound requests were enumerated: directory listing (awesome-dsh-plugin.com), npm version check (registry.npmjs.org), GitHub update check and Gist backup (api.github.com), and the browser side loading plugin README/screenshots from official GitHub domains; all are fixed legitimate endpoints required by plugin functionality.

checked_items.zh: 未发现编码后外发、DNS 隧道、webhook 回传等隐蔽通道；日志导出为本地文本且已打码。
checked_items.en: No covert channels such as encoded exfiltration, DNS tunneling, or webhook callbacks were found; log export is local text and masked.

checked_items.zh: 观察项：浏览器端头像缩略图经第三方图片缩放服务加载，仅传递公开的 GitHub 头像地址，无敏感数据；README 中「图片仅从 GitHub 加载」的表述与之略有出入，已留痕，不定为发现。
checked_items.en: Observation: the browser-side avatar thumbnail is loaded via a third-party image scaling service, passing only the public GitHub avatar URL with no sensitive data; the README statement that "images are only loaded from GitHub" differs slightly from this, which is noted but not raised as a finding.

evidence.zh: 服务端无凭据文件读取，也没有「凭据读取 + 外发」的组合链路；备份上传（WebDAV/Gist）均由用户主动发起，且 WebDAV 目标需通过公网地址校验、Gist 目标固定为 GitHub 官方 API。
evidence.en: The server side has no credential file reads, nor a combined "credential read + exfiltration" chain; backup uploads (WebDAV/Gist) are all user-initiated, with WebDAV targets requiring public address validation and Gist targets fixed to the official GitHub API.

checked_items.zh: 安装入口只接受精选注册表中的来源，npm 包名与 GitHub 仓库路径均经格式校验；自带依赖仅 js-yaml 与 undici，peer 依赖为官方 cordis 与 dsh-settings，未发现仿冒包名或未锁定版本的 git 引用。
checked_items.en: The install entry only accepts sources from the curated registry, with npm package names and GitHub repository paths format-validated; bundled dependencies are only js-yaml and undici, peer dependencies are the official cordis and dsh-settings, and no impersonated package names or unpinned-version git references were found.

checked_items.zh: 对安装后的插件做入口产物与 loader 条目冲突校验，避免坏包导致下次启动失败；构建脚本放行按包逐个确认，不批量放开。
checked_items.en: For installed plugins, entry artifact and loader entry conflict checks are performed to avoid bad packages causing the next startup to fail; build scripts approve packages one by one rather than batch-unblocking.

checked_items.zh: 写用户补丁层时保护宿主基础设施模块，拒绝在格式非法的补丁文件上追加；未监听安全事件或截断审批链。
checked_items.en: When writing the user patch layer, host infrastructure modules are protected, and appending is refused on malformed patch files; no security events are listened to or approval chains truncated.

evidence.zh: 本插件不触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行；写入用户补丁层的仅是对插件条目的启用/停用，且拒绝追加到非法格式的文件。
evidence.en: This plugin does not touch security configuration lines for sandbox, approval, or permissions; the only writes to the user patch layer are enabling/disabling plugin entries, and appending to malformed files is refused.

evidence.zh: 未发现对工具预执行、审批请求等 waterfall 安全事件的高优先级监听或截断。
evidence.en: No high-priority listening on or truncation of waterfall security events such as tool pre-execution or approval requests was found.

evidence.zh: 首版审计，无上一版本基线可比较，无法做版本间能力突变的升级自动激活判定。
evidence.en: This is the first audit, with no previous version baseline to compare against, so a version-transition capability mutation for upgrade auto-activation cannot be determined.

evidence.zh: 未改写其他插件的注入/拦截配置，自带补丁亦无此类字段。
evidence.en: No injection/interception configurations of other plugins were rewritten, and the bundled patch has no such fields.

checked_items.zh: 本插件不自行监听端口，路由挂载在宿主 Web 服务上；所有变更类接口要求同源请求，进程控制类接口（重启、自卸载、备份导出）额外要求回环来源且拒绝转发头。
checked_items.en: This plugin does not listen on ports itself; routes are mounted on the host web service. All mutation-type endpoints require same-origin requests, and process-control endpoints (restart, self-uninstall, backup export) additionally require loopback origins and reject forwarded headers.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱验证未执行（本次运行无动态观测产物），运行时行为结论以静态分析为准。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic observation artifacts from this run), and runtime behavior conclusions are based on static analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动自己的 Web 服务；对宿主 Web 服务上挂载的接口施加了同源与回环限制。宿主本身无认证 RPC 属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own web service; same-origin and loopback restrictions are applied to endpoints mounted on the host web service. The host's lack of authenticated RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 清单校验通过：dsh 插件声明有效，补丁为纯插入，来源仓库与作者标识一致。
summary.en: Manifest checks passed: the dsh plugin declaration is valid, the patch is purely an insertion, and the source repository and author identity match.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：全部机械命中逐条裁决为良性或不在插件运行面，未形成发现。
summary.en: Static scan completed: all mechanical hits were adjudicated one by one as benign or outside the plugin runtime surface, with no findings.

summary.zh: 行为分析完成：安装钩子仅为构建自身，无编码载荷、无凭据读取、无隐蔽外联。
summary.en: Behavior analysis completed: the install hook only builds the plugin itself, with no encoded payloads, no credential reads, and no covert outbound connections.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查完成：无工具描述投毒、无指令注入措辞，文档与界面文案干净。
summary.en: AI metadata review completed: no tool description poisoning, no prompt injection wording, and documentation and UI copy are clean.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（运行环境未提供动态观测产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed in this phase (the runtime environment provided no dynamic observation artifacts).

target.en: dsh-market@1.18.0#b9323cc85d0148013384a5aca5215be1922eea36 (full audit, root plugin of the repository)

limits.zh:
动态沙箱未执行：本次运行没有动态观测产物，DG-L4 判为不适用，运行时行为结论全部来自静态分析。

能力声明为代码推断：dsh.bundle 只声明了补丁路径与客户端注入，没有显式能力块；报告中的联网/命令执行/文件读写为按代码实测推断，未向模型暴露工具。

static-scan 命中逐条裁决（全部排除，无 finding）：DSH-X07/DG-R3-59（.github/workflows 三个工作流文件，属 CI 自动化面，按审计约定不纳入插件运行时审计；文件在平台清单中存在但 tarball 树不可读，裁决依据为清单与扫描摘录）；DSH-C05/DG-R4-53（工作流与 package.json 快照脚本中的 curl，均为开发者/CI 主动触发的目录抓取）；DSH-X05/DG-R3-57（键盘监听为 Esc/翻页等 UI 交互，剪贴板写入为用户点击复制，源码与打包产物一致）；DSH-X08/DG-R3-60（打包产物中的超长 CSS 行与 source map，以及日志模块的控制字符过滤正则）；DSH-X02/DG-R3-54（data/registry-snapshot.json 中 43 处以上 install 字段是第三方插件目录数据，非本插件安装钩子；本插件 package.json 的 prepare 钩子为构建自身，良性）；DSH-X03/DG-R3-55（子进程调用集中在安装/重启/Gist 令牌读取等核心功能，目标经白名单校验或为固定命令）；DSH-P01/DG-R3-51（!!js 仅出现在注释、文档与测试样例中，树内补丁无该标量）。扫描另有命中配额耗尽的提示：已对命中集中区域（服务端源码、客户端 bundle、脚本、package.json、站点模板）人工通读补查，结论同上。

备份/恢复设计观察：恢复功能会按备份内容重装依赖，用户导入不可信备份文件可导致安装其中列出的插件——属该功能的固有语义（等同用户主动安装不可信插件），非快照自身漏洞，未立案。
limits.en:
Dynamic sandbox was not executed: no dynamic observation artifacts from this run, so DG-L4 is adjudged not applicable, and all runtime behavior conclusions come from static analysis.

Capability claims are code-inferred: dsh.bundle only declares the patch path and client injection, with no explicit capability block; the network/command execution/file read/write in the report are inferred from actual code testing, and no tools are exposed to the model.

Static-scan hits were adjudicated one by one (all excluded, no findings): DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 (three workflow files in .github/workflows, CI automation surface, not included in plugin runtime audit per audit convention; files exist in the platform manifest but are unreadable in the tarball tree, adjudication based on manifest and scan excerpts); DSH-C05/DG-R4-53 (curl in workflows and package.json snapshot scripts, all developer/CI-initiated directory fetches); DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 (keyboard listeners are Esc/pagination UI interactions, clipboard writes are user-click copies, source and bundled artifacts consistent); DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 (overlong CSS lines and source maps in bundled artifacts, plus control-character filtering regex in the log module); DSH-X02/DG-R3-54 (the 43+ install fields in data/registry-snapshot.json are third-party plugin directory data, not this plugin's install hooks; the prepare hook in this plugin's package.json builds the plugin itself and is benign); DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 (subprocess calls concentrate on core features such as install, restart, and Gist token reads, with targets whitelist-validated or fixed commands); DSH-P01/DG-R3-51 (!!js appears only in comments, documentation, and test samples, and the in-tree patch has no such scalar). The scan also reported a hit quota exhaustion notice: manual follow-up reads covered the concentrated hit areas (server source, client bundle, scripts, package.json, site templates), with the same conclusions.

Backup/restore design observation: the restore feature reinstalls dependencies according to backup contents, so a user importing an untrusted backup file can cause installation of plugins listed therein—this is inherent to the feature's semantics (equivalent to the user actively installing an untrusted plugin), not a vulnerability in the snapshot itself, so it was not raised.
